name: Aparhant (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Aparhant: a red, white and green shield with a bunch of grapes, ears of grain, roses and a ploughshare, below a scroll inscribed APARHANT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
